The Airport on the Other Side of the Map

地图另一端的机场 · 647 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A regional airline was preparing for a short flight across a coastal mountain range. Its twin-engine aircraft carried passengers and a small load of medical cargo. A pilot named Mira was checking the runway when a radio message announced a delay. Fog had covered the destination airport. An attendant told the passengers to stay in the terminal. A family due to join a cruise wanted the plane to depart immediately. Mira said takeoff depended on where they could land, not on whether the first runway looked clear.

2One nonstop flight normally took forty minutes. The other route included a layover inland. The dispatcher had already announced a cancellation after a radar outage. Mira checked whether it affected the whole fleet. The inland terminal still had its own telecommunications link. A helicopter crew used a different frequency. The dispatcher entered it and assessed the alternate runway before asking a twin-engine jet to depart. In aviation a clear first leg could not settle a problem at the far end.

3A child asked why the flight map had a route over water. His father had once sailed on a small naval ship and knew where a cruiser could find anchorage. In fog a sailor might wait offshore. An aircraft needed a landing strip. The father had booked a sightseeing cruise after arrival and could use a ferry if the postponement lasted all day. Mira said they could choose a different trip without treating the timetable as a reason to hurry.

4The cargo mattered to a clinic, but it did not have to travel aboard that particular plane. An ambulance driver was waiting near the foggy airport. The clinic told the airline it could meet him at the inland terminal instead. A dispatcher changed his assignment and arranged to transfer the load after arrival. A second employee checked the labels so one box would not stay aboard during the return trip. The medical team could receive its supplies without making a pilot attempt a risky approach.

5The crew took off after the alternate cleared them. An aerial survey craft had flown along the hills and sent a report about a low band of cloud. A radio operator checked its position and confirmed it was descending away from the passenger route. Mira followed the briefed procedure. A sudden gap looked tempting, but the chief pilot had explained why a passing view of a runway did not make a descent safe. She waited for the recorded landing conditions.

6The child's father also showed him a picture of a weather satellite. The boy had thought a spacecraft could see the airport from above the clouds and tell a pilot where to land. A rocket, an astronaut's capsule, and a passenger jet used very different signals. Mira pointed to the radio tower at the alternate. The crew needed a useful local report before a satellite image could make sense for this trip.

7An airport marshal guided them to the stand. The child watched the ambulance leave with the cargo. His father was disappointed that the original connection had been cancelled. A coastal route might be better when the family went sailing, but today a bus could take them beyond the fog. Mira recorded the regrettable delay and the safe arrival separately. The same decision could complicate one journey while protecting two. The child put the map beside a balloon picture. He traced the airport and the nearby navy dock.

8Mira kept both airports on the training map. A new pilot wanted to know whether frequent delays meant the airline should offer only inland flights. She pointed to the original route, where service was usually punctual. Then she showed the marked alternate. She had learned the distinction on her maiden flight as a trainee. An adventurous route could sound impressive. A routine flight was ready when someone could explain what they would do at either end.

四级汇总词汇 · 41中文译文

地图另一端的机场

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一家地区航空公司准备飞一趟短程航班，跨过沿海山脉。双引擎飞机上有乘客，也装了一小批医疗物资。飞行员米拉正在检查跑道，无线电里传来延误消息。目的地机场起了雾。乘务员请乘客留在航站楼。一家人赶着登游轮，希望飞机马上起飞。米拉说，起飞前要先确定哪里能降落。眼前这条跑道看得清，还不够。

2直达航班平时只要四十分钟，另一条航线则要在内陆停留。雷达出现故障，签派员已经通知取消一个航班。米拉核实故障会不会影响整个机队。内陆航站楼还有独立的通信线路，一组直升机飞行员也在用另一个频率。签派员输入那个频率，评估备降跑道，再安排一架双引擎喷气客机起飞。前半程看得清，后半程的问题仍要单独处理。

3一个孩子问，航线图上为什么有一段经过海面。他父亲以前乘过小型军舰，知道巡航船在哪里能抛锚。遇到雾，水手可以在近海等待，飞机则要有跑道降落。父亲原本预订了到站后的观光船。如果一拖就是一天，他们还可以坐渡轮。米拉说，一家人可以换个出游安排，没必要让时刻表催着飞机起飞。

4这批物资对诊所很重要，却可以换一架飞机运。原目的地机场附近有一位救护车司机在等。诊所告诉航空公司，可以改在内陆航站楼跟司机会合。签派员改了司机的任务，安排飞机落地后移交货物。另一位员工再核对标签，免得返程时有一箱还留在飞机上。这样医疗人员能拿到物资，也用不着请飞行员在有风险的地方进近。

5收到备降机场的许可后，机组起飞了。一架空中勘测飞机沿丘陵飞过，发来低空云带的报告。无线电操作员核实它的位置，确认它正在远离客机航线的方向下降。米拉按照事先说明的程序飞行。云层突然露了个口，看着可以往下飞，但首席飞行员讲过，偶然瞥见跑道，还不足以判断下降安全。她等候正式记录的降落条件。

6父亲还给孩子看了一张气象卫星的图片。男孩原先以为，航天器能从云层上方看到机场，再告诉飞行员去哪里降落。火箭、载人太空舱和喷气客机使用的信号差别很大。米拉指着备降机场的无线电塔。对这趟航班来说，机组要先拿到有用的当地报告，才能用上卫星图。

7机场引导员把飞机带到停机位。孩子看见救护车载着物资离开。原定接驳取消了，父亲很失望。等家人以后坐船时，沿海路线或许更合适，可今天坐巴士就能绕到雾外。米拉分别记下遗憾的延误和安全到达的结果。同一个决定给一趟行程添了麻烦，同时保住了两趟行程的安全。孩子把地图放在一张气球图旁，描出了机场和附近的海军码头。

8米拉在训练地图上保留了两座机场。一位新飞行员问，常常延误的话，公司是否只该飞内陆。她先指着原航线，那里平时大多很准时，然后又指给他看标出的备降机场。她自己还是实习飞行员、第一次执行飞行时，就学会了区分这两件事。一条冒险的航线说起来很了不起。真正准备好飞普通航班的人，能讲清楚两头各有什么安排。
